why: Today's CI tooling. Ticket 1076's delivery layer, tests step. Laws D1 to D5 and O1 to O4 of the approved plan are written, and all 18 paths of its Files table are written: the nine test paths and the nine product paths (related.ts with delivered, confirmed, checkDelivery, checkFault, the archive and consumer outputs and the --receipt and --fault modes; changes.mjs; legs.ts; check.yaml; and the five guard modules), because every path under .github is an exam path the build step may not own. Before the product was written each new law was red against today's code for the reason the plan gives.
note: No older law was removed or narrowed. Existing changes.test.ts cases that spelled the full filter as next/ now spell next/ kalfa/. With the real product files every changed test file is green: record 33, plant-related 1, related-selection 22, legs 23, related 120, changes 61, guard related 54, guard changes 72, merge-line 89, next-job 181. The 53 plants were run against the real files, one at a time and each restored, and every one was red (one needed its edit text updated to the formatted guard and was then red). pnpm lint exits 0, pnpm typecheck exits 0, the list ratchet exits 0, oxfmt is clean. The --fault runner follows the plan's five steps with the restore in a scope finalizer and is not run here: outside CI it refuses with reason environment and touches nothing. Not run here: P2's real install, the real --fault red and green run. Recorded start is the session's first observed timestamp; usage and cost are unknown.
